description: Generate new content themes using AI. Waits a short grace window for generation to finish; if it's still running server-side after that, returns a 'generating' status instead of blocking — call list_themes a few seconds later to retrieve the new themes. Deducts credits.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

input.description: Source text or file path to derive themes from

instructions.description: Custom instructions, e.g. 'Focus on startup growth'

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated.

name: generate_themes
